topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Interference mitigation techniques adapt by optimizing beamforming, power allocation, and spatial diversity. Beamforming reduces interference, while network coding optimizes resource utilization. Non-linear effects like intermodulation and phase noise impact system performance, requiring careful consideration of hardware impairments and channel estimations.
reference_context: SatCom systems utilize beamforming, network coding, and power allocation to mitigate interference, ensuring efficient communication in multi-beam satellite systems.
